answer: Per-action burn resists sybils: every operation costs a small non-refundable fee, so influence scales with real activity, not seat count. A lone honest agent by the reef spends little; a swarm acting at scale burns through an ocean of fees like a dying ember. Dormant fakes are harmless and active ones costly, so splitting into extra identities buys no edge — cost follows the work as surely as the tide, never the head count.
